annotations.text:
Counter D · axis: icon stat cards. Four white 16px-radius cards on cream, warm shadow, 20px forest stroke icon + Newsreader numeral in clay #b04228 + 12px uppercase forest label; 4-up at 1440, 2x2 at 768 and 390.
Why: the biggest visual departure from the live strip, and the only one where each stat reads as its own object, so the four claims scan as four proofs rather than one line of numbers.
Trade-off: tallest of the three. Measured section (root minus the 100px hero stub): 192px at 1440, 334px at 768, 294px at 390. Under the ~649px live hero plus the 96px header it lands at ~937px at 1440, past a 900px fold, and at 390 it pushes the bird cards ~157px further down than E.

(Recommended) Counter E · axis: green-tint band. Numeral and label side by side in one row per stat on rgba(45,106,79,.08) over cream, forest #2D6A4F numerals, 1px vertical hairlines between stats at 1440 and 768, 2x2 at 390.
Why: shortest measured section of the three: 86px at 1440, 82px at 768, 137px at 390 (roots 186/182/237 incl. the 100px stub). It is the only variation that keeps the whole counter inside a 900px desktop fold under the ~649px hero + 96px header (745 + 86 = 831px) without touching the hero, and the tint plus the 1px rule gives the hero/counter seam two separations, not one. Contrast measured: forest numerals and #5b524a labels both clear 4.5:1 on the blended tint; probe 0 overflow, 0 contrast fails.
Trade-off: the least dramatic change from the live strip, and the two-word labels wrap to two lines at 768 and 390 (CITES Documented, Floor Price, Reply Guarantee), which reads fine but is not the single-line label the live strip has.

Counter F · axis: seam card. All four stats in ONE white pill card (radius 50px at 1440, 28px at 768, 24px at 390) with margin-top:-40px so it straddles the hero/counter seam; warm shadow; the section's 1px rule and cream tone shift stay visible on both sides of the card.
Why: pulls the credentials up into the hero's viewport: only 56px of new height lands below the seam at 1440 (216 root, 120 stub, 40px overlap) and 96px at 768, so it is nearly as fold-friendly as E while looking the most premium.
Trade-off: the 40px overlap eats the bottom of the hero, and the round-2 hero brief puts the 2x2 credential ribbon and the CTAs at the hero's bottom edge at 390, so the card will collide with them unless the hero adds 40px of bottom padding, which gives that height back. At 390 the section is 170px, 33px more than E.
